title: STIX Source
markdown: Structured Threat Information Expression (STIX) sources deliver threat intel in Intel Exchange in the STIX format. The supported STIX formats are STIX 1.x, STIX 2.0, and STIX 2.1. Use the following APIs to retrieve details about STIX sources and collections. For more information, see [STIX Source](https://techdocs.cyware.com/ctix/en/stix-sources.html).
